enchantments.tooltip: Deception +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to hit and +17 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Seeker +14: Provides a +14 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +14 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Reflex Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
